name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
summary: Cyclone Akvan under GDACS orange alert; IMD expects very severe cyclone landfall in Andhra Pradesh near noon on 20 Nov
state: GDACS kept an orange alert for Tropical Cyclone Akvan, affecting India, at 05:35 UTC on 17 Nov, with winds near 102 km/h (GDACS). IMD's bulletin early on 17 Nov forecast it to become a very severe cyclonic storm by 19 Nov and cross the Andhra Pradesh coast between Nellore and Tuni around noon on 20 Nov, with winds of 120–130 km/h gusting to 145 km/h (NewsMeter). Odisha has ordered evacuations in six southern districts (Daily Jagran). An orange alert sets Watch.
for_you: People in coastal Andhra Pradesh and southern Odisha should follow India Meteorological Department warnings and state disaster authority instructions. Travellers should check FCDO travel advice; flights, rail and ferries may be disrupted around 19–21 Nov.
rubric_hit: GDACS orange cyclone alert (Akvan, India) = Watch; IMD forecasts landfall on 20 Nov, beyond 72h

drivers: Ocean heat, ENSO phase, season (W Pacific peaks Jul–Oct; N Indian Apr–Jun & Oct–Dec).

rubric.alert: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange cyclone alert, or a typhoon/cyclone threatening land within 72h.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red tropical cyclone alerts.
